title.zh: 美国国土安全部下令联邦民事机构移除DeepSeek产品，中国外交部回应
title.en: DHS orders DeepSeek products removed from federal civilian agency systems

current_state.zh: 美国以国家安全担忧为由，下令联邦文职机构移除DeepSeek AI产品及使用其技术构建的第三方服务。
current_state.en: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek AI products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.

updates.title_zh: 美国土安全部下令将DeepSeek产品排除在民用政府机构系统之外
updates.title_en: 美国土安全部下令将DeepSeek产品排除在民用政府机构系统之外
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国国土安全部下令将DeepSeek及相关产品（包括集成DeepSeek的第三方服务）排除在联邦民事机构采购之外，并从其IT系统中移除。
updates.what_changed_en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek and related products, including third-party services incorporating DeepSeek, to be excluded from federal civilian agency procurement and removed from their IT systems.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国国土安全部下令将DeepSeek及相关产品（包括集成DeepSeek的第三方服务）排除在联邦民事机构采购之外，并从其IT系统中移除。
updates.current_state_en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek and related products, including third-party services incorporating DeepSeek, to be excluded from federal civilian agency procurement and removed from their IT systems.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek and related products, including third-party services incorporating DeepSeek, to be excluded from federal civilian agency procurement and removed from their IT systems.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek and related products, including third-party services incorporating DeepSeek, to be excluded from federal civilian agency procurement and removed from their IT systems.

updates.title_zh: 中国外交部回应美政府禁用中国AI
updates.title_en: 中国外交部回应美政府禁用中国AI
updates.what_changed_zh: 中国外交部就美国要求联邦机构停止使用DeepSeek等中国AI产品作出回应，批评美方将科技问题政治化，并表示将坚决维护中国企业的合法权益。
updates.what_changed_en: China's Foreign Ministry responded to the U.S. requirement that federal agencies stop using Chinese AI products including DeepSeek, criticizing the politicization of technology and vowing to protect Chinese companies' lawful rights.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国国土安全部要求联邦民用机构移除DeepSeek及相关产品；中国外交部已公开回应，批评美方将科技问题政治化，并承诺维护中国企业的合法权益。
updates.current_state_en: DHS has ordered DeepSeek and related products removed from federal civilian agency systems; China's Foreign Ministry has publicly responded, criticizing the politicization of technology and pledging to protect Chinese companies' lawful rights.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: China's Foreign Ministry criticized the U.S. requirement that federal agencies stop using Chinese AI products including DeepSeek, calling it politicization of technology and vowing to protect Chinese companies' rights.
updates.detailed_summary_en: China's Foreign Ministry criticized the U.S. requirement that federal agencies stop using Chinese AI products including DeepSeek, calling it politicization of technology and vowing to protect Chinese companies' rights.

updates.title_zh: 美国下令联邦机构从系统中移除中国的DeepSeek AI
updates.title_en: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国以国家安全担忧为由，下令联邦文职机构移除DeepSeek AI产品及使用其技术构建的第三方服务。
updates.what_changed_en: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek AI products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国以国家安全担忧为由，下令联邦文职机构移除DeepSeek AI产品及使用其技术构建的第三方服务。
updates.current_state_en: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek AI products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek AI products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek AI products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.
updates.background_zh: 华盛顿与北京正在争夺人工智能领域的领导地位，而成立于2023年、开源了DeepSeek-V3、R1等模型的中国公司DeepSeek一直是这场竞争的关注焦点。美国此前的限制覆盖商务部以及国防、安全和情报部门的部分机构。澳大利亚于2025年2月禁止在政府系统和设备上使用DeepSeek产品。中国《环球时报》报道称，在美方采取此举后，北京表示将坚决维护本国企业的权益。
updates.background_en: Washington and Beijing are competing for leadership in artificial intelligence, and DeepSeek — a Chinese company founded in 2023 that publishes open-source models such as DeepSeek-V3 and R1 — has been a focal point of that rivalry. Earlier US restrictions covered the Commerce Department and portions of the defense, security and intelligence community. Australia banned DeepSeek products from government systems and devices in February 2025. China's Global Times reported that Beijing vowed to protect its firms' rights following the US move.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该指令重塑了联邦文职机构及其供应商的采购格局：将DeepSeek模型嵌入政府相关产品的企业需要承担合规与重构成本，而以联邦业务为目标的美国本土模型供应商则面对更少的竞争者。对加密市场而言，主要传导渠道是围绕中国开源权重AI模型和去中心化AI叙事的情绪，而非直接敞口，因为该命令针对的是联邦IT采购，而非数字资产。
updates.market_impact_en: The directive reshapes procurement for federal civilian agencies and their vendors, so companies that embedded DeepSeek models in government-facing products face compliance and re-engineering costs, while US-based model providers positioned for federal work face a narrower competitive field. For crypto markets, the main channel is sentiment around open-weight Chinese AI models and decentralized-AI narratives rather than any direct exposure, since the order targets federal IT procurement rather than digital assets.
